title: Bump dompurify from 2.0.12 to 2.0.17
description:
Bumps [dompurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) from 2.0.12 to 2.0.17.
Release notes

Sourced from dompurify's releases.

DOMPurify 2.0.17

  • Fixed another bypass causing mXSS by using MathML

DOMPurify 2.0.16

  • Fixed an mXSS-based bypass caused by nested forms inside MathML
  • Fixed a security error thrown on older Chrome on Android versions, see #470

Credits for the bypass go to Michał Bentkowski (@securityMB) of Securitum who spotted the bug in Chrome, turned it into another DOMPurify bypass, reported and helped verifying the fix :bowing_man: :bowing_woman:

DOMPurify 2.0.15

  • Added a renovated test suite, thanks @peernohell
  • Fixed some minor linter warnings

DOMPurify 2.0.14

  • Fixed a problem with the documentMode default value

title: Address min/max cols
description: Address min/max col display. There is still some question on how to handle the min/max row display. Partly due to the fact that now we accept HTML, we cannot pre-define the number of pages that exist if we try to limit to a specific div height.

title: Add HTML to output
description:
This PR adds some additional flexibility and re-writes a chunk of the internals to paged table. 

Main updates are 
- Outputs can be rendered as HTML. I added the additional option for "html", where the user can specify which columns to render as HTML, and which to leave as normal text. Currently for testing I used just internalHTML method, but we should switch back to the html/js cleaning before attempting to render. 

- Now rather than re-rendering the viewable "page" of data, I have taken a hide/collapse approach. the table starts initially empty. Then as it starts to fill in the table with viewable columns. The entire column has the html generated (we can add limits to say 1000),but only the viewable columns are generated. on navigating to the right, rather than deleting the columns, they are hidden so we don't have to re-render them.

- I switched from the "slide in" transformation to a simpler opacity change, but this can be changed

title: Drop Overflow = "auto"
description:
When paging left and right, temporarily the table is wider than the div defining the paged table, so a slider bar appears for a split second. This should drop that off.

I don't think this should impact anything else

title: Update vue.html
description: The method you are currently using does not work, since you are using a shadowDOM. but we can remove the entire div and re-create it and it is functional again. should resolve #1
